mentions.name: Stripe Integration as a Library
mentions.description: A stack-agnostic JS/TS library that packages Stripe integration, covering the steps every team repeats when adding subscriptions: creating the database table, setting up webhooks, and implementing the events they care about. Built on a framework for stack-agnostic libraries, with database support for Drizzle and Kysely and Prisma support coming soon. Inspired by the Stripe integration built for better-auth.
mentions.problem: Whenever someone uses Stripe (e.g., for subscriptions), they go through the same few steps—creating a database table, setting up webhooks, and implementing events—and the challenge is that everyone uses a different stack.
